copy.anchor: Security baseline for year one: what a first-year SaaS security baseline can draw from OWASP ASVS, NIST SSDF and the AICPA Trust Services Criteria. A reading guide, not an audit; it describes no control operated at any company. (/research/)
copy.convey: Layers of a baseline, read from public standards.
copy.avoid: A padlock, shield, key or seal; any claim that a control exists.

prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of three nested six-sided hexagonal shells in brushed steel, frosted glass and matte blue, each slightly larger than the last. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one small hexagon tile at the centre, in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
